notes.title: Release notes January 12th, 2025
notes.notes:
Hello!

We've just released a new update of the game, we've focused on improving the evolution of the budget (and the sponsor offers) over the seasons. The game will now be more rewarding when your team gets promoted for example.

We've also fixed and improved a few things around the satisfaction of your directors.

[list]
[*] Fixed display of shooting charts on old saves
[*] Fixed display of score evolution on old saves
[*] Fixed budget evolution when getting promoted
[*] Fixed satisfaction of directors at the end of the season
[*] Improved budget evolution when reaching goals
[*] Fixed satisfaction of directors when you renew your contract
[/list]

notes.title: Release notes January 8th, 2025 (Saving time optimization)
notes.notes:
Hello,

We've have just released a new update of the game which should drastically improve the time taken to save your careers (divided by 10 on some laptops).

The updates also contains several bug fixes and optimizations around saving/loading careers.

We are very grateful for the feedback we've received  in the last days which has helped us finding the bottlenecks in the saving process.

A new career is not needed to get the faster saving time.

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Release notes January 5th, 2025
notes.notes:

[list]

[/list]

notes.title: Simulation update
notes.notes:
Hello,

First of all we'd like to thank you for your amazing feedback over the last weeks.

A new update of the game is now live, it will improve drastically the simulation scores. The differences between played and simulated games has been fixed and several adjustments have been made to improve the realism of simulations (number of shots taken per game, %s...).

We will keep working on reported bugs and will keep improving the simulations :)

Besides the changes around the italian leagues, a new career is not needed.

Here is the full changelog:
[list]
[*] Improved rotations with fouls
[*] Improved differences between played and simulated games
[*] Fixed evolution of the score when simulating parts of 3D games
[*] Fixed slow pages when fetching persons
[*] Fixed saving the age of persons
[*] Fixed simulated games having lower scores than played games
[*] Fixed formation not properly applied in 3D games
[*] Scores in the American league improved
[*] Fixed schedule of Italian league 2
[*] Fixed cup in italian second division
[*] Improved layout of stands information on small resolution
[*] Fixed saving of colors in the stands of the arena
[*] Fixed saving of the number of seats in the stands of the arena
[/list]

We wish you a great end of the year!

notes.title: Christmas update!
notes.notes:
Hello,

We're glad to release the first big update of the year. It contains numerous updates in the simulation algorithm.

Our focus has been to improve how the players behave in the games (simulated and played) to reach a higher level of realism. You will for example note that Point Guards will shoot much less compared to the other players with the update. Your offensive leaders will receive more balls and take more shots!

In addition to that we've improved the shooting percentages, the number of turnovers and steals per games, the number of assists, or the rotations from the AI (to avoid benching the best players too much for example).

We'll keep focusing on the simulations and the bugs in the next updates. Our goal is simple: improve the simulations and the realism of the games.

As announced on discord, we'll also release a new version of the dataeditor soon fixing several issues and allowing the community to edit the sponsors!

Have a great evening!

Full changelog:
[list]
[*] Fixed sex of prospects when using a women’s team
[*] offensive leaders will take more shots during games
[*] Improved the Free throw % in games
[*] Improved number of turnovers / game
[*] Improved number of steals / game
[*] Defensive leaders will now steal more balls
[*] Defensive leaders will now block more balls
[*] Players that are not offensive leaders will take less shots after screens
[*] Players that are not offensive leaders will drive less after screens
[*] Players will distribute the ball more after screens
[*] When the time is running out, the players will try to give the ball to the offensive leaders for the buzzer beaters
[*] Improved shooting %
[*] Fixed calculation of 6th man for simulated games
[*] DATAEDITOR: Improved CSV import for players (data validation of contracts)
[*] Improved shot repartition, PGs will shoot less
[*] Improved AI rotations around fouls
[*] Improved 3D animations of defenders looking the wrong way sometimes (or switching too fast on drives for example)
[*] Improved AI rotations where they would bench leaders too much
[*] Improved where defenders are looking in 3D when fouling automatically
[*] 
[/list]

notes.title: Devblog: 3D Facilities Management
notes.notes:
[h1]3D Facilities Management: A New Era in PBM![/h1]

We’re excited to introduce the [b]3D Facilities Management[/b] feature in Pro Basketball Manager 2025, allowing players to customize and upgrade their club's infrastructure like never before! For the first time in PBM history, you can choose from [b]13 different buildings[/b] to enhance your income, improve your youth academy, training center, and much more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45187576/bd7141b03df8c4ef51aa5297d2d0b5d008a394a8.jpg[/img]

[b]Full Control Over Club Development![/b]

Whether you want to strengthen your youth academy or boost revenue through shops and bars, the choice is yours. Upgrading facilities grants you [b]strategic advantages[/b] that can lead your club to success:

- [b]Youth Academy:[/b] Develop a top-notch academy to attract better players with higher potential and faster development.
- [b]Shops and Bars:[/b] Increase your revenue streams by improving sales and unlocking special items!
- [b]VIP Areas:[/b] Create exclusive spaces to entice bigger sponsors and elevate your club's prestige.
- [b]Museum:[/b] Celebrate your club's history and generate passive income for the long run.
And 9 more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45187576/90c516bcd74effe4422358b44022fad11631deeb.png[/img]

[b]Manage Your Budget Wisely![/b]

With the new facilities feature, you'll have unprecedented control over your budget and club development. Players will need to carefully evaluate which facilities to upgrade based on their current goals and strategies. 

Get ready to take your club to the next level in PBM with the exciting new [b]3D Facilities Management[/b] feature! Stay tuned for more updates, and join us on this thrilling journey to create your dream basketball club!

[video]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yPtpSeiZMHA[/video]

notes.title: Devblog: Dynamic sponsors system
notes.notes:
[b]We are thrilled to announce that Pro Basketball Manager 2025 will feature a completely new and dynamic sponsors system![/b]

[h1]A New Era in Team Budget Management[/h1]

For many years, managing the team's budget has been a core challenge in [b]Pro Basketball Manager[/b]. Traditionally, you would start a season with a pre-assigned budget, which would reset at the beginning of the next season. Following last year's groundwork on budgets, we've taken it a step further to rebuild the financial aspect of the game and, for the first time ever, introduce sponsors.

[h1]Introducing Sponsors[/h1]

In [b]Pro Basketball Manager 2025[/b], you now have full control over your team's budget, which will be influenced by the sponsors you choose. At the start of each season, you'll receive sponsor offers based on your team's performance and reputation within your league. Sponsors are divided into three categories:

[list]
[*][b]Main Sponsor[/b]
[*][b]Secondary Sponsor[/b]
[*][b]Minor Sponsor[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45187576/90a10c16b727e3d749f344262420825f1fd65d57.jpg[/img]


Each sponsor type comes with unique bonuses that can be unlocked by achieving specific objectives that the sponsor values.

[h1]Sponsor Objectives[/h1]

Objectives can vary, but here are a few examples:

[list]
[*]Having a certain number of players from the sponsor's nationality
[*]Including a specific number of young players in your roster
[*]Winning your league
[*]Qualifying for the playoffs
[*]Winning 70% of your home games
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45187576/f72bd59f6198e322f3cf79d1d0e7df6af18a366e.png[/img]

[h1]Risk and Reward[/h1]

For each type of sponsor, you'll receive multiple offers with varying levels of risk and reward:

[list]
[*][b]Safer offers[/b]: These come with a higher base payment and fewer bonuses, providing steady and reliable funding.
[*][b]Riskier offers[/b]: These have a lower base payment but offer significantly higher bonuses if you meet the sponsor's objectives.
[/list]

[h1]Strategic Depth[/h1]

We believe that the choice of sponsors will add a new strategic dimension to [b]Pro Basketball Manager 2025[/b]. Will you tailor your roster to meet your sponsors' goals for maximum bonuses, or play it safe and focus on consistent base funding? The decision is yours, and it will shape the way you manage your team's finances and build your roster.

This is just the first stone in a revolution for budget management in [b]Pro Basketball Manager[/b]. We are committed to continuously evolving and enhancing the financial aspects of the game, providing you with deeper, more engaging management experiences.

We can't wait for you to experience this new feature and see how it transforms your approach to team management. Stay tuned for more updates as we get closer to the release!

Make sure to follow our social media channels, or chat directly with us by joining our [url=https://discord.gg/G5qzSR7jzD]discord server[/url] to get the latest updates about the series.
